blocks.text: Zscaler's customers often access destinations that require traffic to egress from a specific IP address that is unique to the organization for authentication. However, when the traffic is forwarded through Zscaler, the client IP address reaching the destination is replaced with a Zscaler IP address, which leads to the traffic being blocked. In such scenarios, organizations might have to risk bypassing some traffic from the Zscaler service, creating a security gap.

To avoid bypassing security checks, Zscaler offers a cloud-based service that allows organizations to be provisioned with dedicated IP addresses and use them as the source IP addresses for their traffic. This enables your users to access SaaS applications or domains that restrict access based on the traffic's source IP address. To learn more about the use cases, see Using Dedicated IP.
To enable dedicated IP addresses for your tenant, follow these steps:

blocks.item: Contact your Zscaler Account team to enable the Dedicated IP feature for your Internet & SaaS (ZIA) tenant.
Provide a list of Zscaler data centers where dedicated IP addresses are needed.

Zscaler provisions dedicated IP addresses for selected Zscaler data centers in the Zscaler Admin Console. An organization is assigned two IP addresses for each data center they are subscribed to. It is possible to increase the number of IP addresses to be allocated at each data center based on your entitlement.
After provisioning, you can configure dedicated IP gateways. These dedicated IP gateways are used to forward traffic through the assigned dedicated source IP address.

Configure dedicated IP forwarding policies and specify all the criteria to be met for forwarding the traffic. Choose the appropriate dedicated IP gateway configured in the previous step to forward traffic using your dedicated egress source IP addresses.

blocks.text: Zscaler recommends subscribing to the Dedicated IP service at a minimum of two Zscaler data centers for redundancy.

You can view the IP addresses provisioned for your organization on the Infrastructure > Internet & SaaS > Network Policies > Dedicated IP > IP Addresses page in the Zscaler Admin Console. Configure granular forwarding policies in the Zscaler Admin Console to forward traffic using the dedicated IP addresses. Zscaler ensures the traffic is secure and that the source IP address is a dedicated IP address assigned to you.
